master:
Edit the FIRST image into a polished production pixel-art Akali character design. The user rejects its crude rectangular white block eyes and wants SHARP ALMOND EYES more like the adult assassin Akali. SECOND image is a detailed character design reference: use its confident sharp eyes and swept fringe as inspiration, while retaining the first image's chibi proportions, original costume and two handheld weapons.
Deliver ONE complete full-body sprite on transparent background, NOT a sheet and no captions. Keep the pose, dark green mask/top, tan skin, charcoal-purple pants, cream wraps, dark gloves and gold bracers, green hip cloth with spiral, black spiky ponytail tied with green band. Near/image-left hand a pointed steel KUNAI; far/image-right hand a short-handled crescent KAMA. No hands swapped. Three-quarter FRONT facing right.
The face is the most important: adult sharp almond-shaped eyes, very small warm-white highlights and clearly brown irises looking right; angular near-black upper eyeliner with slightly raised outer corners, a narrow tan nose bridge between the eyes. Eyes are separate tapered shapes NOT upright white rectangles, not a white horizontal bar, not a cartoon robot, not googly or sleepy. Near eye slightly wider than far eye because of perspective. One logical pixel of skin between eyes and dark-green mask; no mouth. Black side-swept fringe must expose both eyes. Elegant alert assassin expression.
Draw TRUE low-resolution 16-bit pixel art with crisp simple stepped edges, not a high-resolution illustration imitating pixels. At standing game resolution, crown-to-soles 46 logical pixels, ponytail-inclusive height 55; face about 14 pixels wide. Use simplified decisive clusters. 27 colors from first image only. Single pixel dark silhouette outline, colored darks inside, broad smooth flat patches, no dithering, no mottled camouflage, no gradient, no glow, no shadow.
1024x1024 canvas logically 128x128 squares enlarged 8x. Match first image placement: soles y99, crown y54, ponytail y45. Entire image has one aligned grid of 8x8 blocks. Transparent RGBA, nothing below soles. Make the eye redesign visibly superior and authentic to Akali while staying readable at tiny native game size.

run.prompt:
Three attached images. FIRST: the approved, final pixel-art design of this character at 8x (every pixel an 8x8 block) - copy its colors, shapes, head, face, mask, weapons and pixel style exactly; do not redesign anything. THIRD: the original 3D animation at the same frames, in the same grid and the same places - copy the motion of the body from it (but never turn her upside down: where the original flips, keep her upright or leaning at most a quarter turn).
The character: Akali (a chibi ninja girl with a huge spiky black ponytail in a green band, a dark green cloth mask over her nose and mouth, sharp brown eyes, tan skin, a sleeveless green crop top with a dark hem, a bare midriff, a tattoo on her near upper arm, dark gloves and gold bracers, a cream sash with a green loincloth, baggy charcoal trousers and cream-bandaged shins; a steel kunai in her near hand and a steel kama (sickle) in her far hand).
Task: draw every frame as clean pixel art identical in style to the FIRST image, at EXACTLY the same pixel size (46 squares from the crown to the soles when standing, 55 with the ponytail), every pixel one crisp 8x8 square on a single 8-px grid, nothing smaller than one square, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no semi-transparency.
Pixel rules (most important): ONLY the 27 colors of the FIRST image, no new colors: #11131D #232632 #223A35 #373440 #343646 #6A3823 #355247 #404956 #484956 #514856 #72552E #4C654B #5B5C66 #687C47 #657183 #A48142 #84945C #BD8157 #A2977D #CCAA5B #DDA372 #97A7B6 #C1B496 #F4BF8B #DED0B1 #C9D5DD #FFF7E5. ONE outline: a 1-square near-black outline around the silhouette and each material's own dark shade inside it - never a second black ring. Big flat areas; no dithering, no noise, no camouflage-like specks, no lone square of a different color inside an area.
The head (hair, hair band, face, eyes, mask) is COPIED from the FIRST image in every frame, square for square, and only moved (or tilted as a whole where the body leans); never redraw it, or it flickers when the frames play. The ponytail is drawn in each frame and swings with the motion. The kunai is always in her NEAR hand (the left one in the image) and the kama in her FAR hand (the right one), as in the FIRST image; they move with her hands, never float free. Her eyes are the NEW FIRST image's sharp almond eyes: narrow stepped near-black upper lashes, very small warm-white glints #FFF7E5, separate brown irises #6A3823 looking right, skin between the eyes and the mask. Near eye slightly wider than far eye. Absolutely NO large square white rectangles, NO vertical white bars, NO round googly eyes. Copy this revised face carefully. Eye colors ONLY in eyes. The dark green mask covers her face below the eyes in every frame.
Feet line: in every cell the lowest row of her feet is square row 81 from the top of the cell (pixels 648 to 655); NOTHING from pixel 656 down - not the kunai, not the kama - because the game draws the health bar there (a fall may dip at most 2 squares). Her place across the cell follows the SECOND image (each frame's standing point is in akali_cells.json). Dashes are moved by the game engine: keep her near her standing point. In a move loop her head keeps the same horizontal place relative to the standing point in every frame.
3/4 FRONT view facing right, never her back, never upside down (except a frame lying on the ground). Do not draw effects (flying kunai, shuriken, slash trails, smoke, glows) - only the character. Use the specified action poses for the first frames and return toward the FIRST image's stance only where the animation description calls for recovery. Run is a continuous run loop; death ends lying still.
Animation: MOVE, 8 frames, one seamless loop of League's run (0.84 s cycle, 8 x 105 ms, the SECOND and THIRD images): she runs low and forward like a ninja, the kunai in her near hand held low and forward, the kama in her far hand trailing, the feet striding as in the THIRD image (frames 1-4 one stride, 5-8 the other); her head keeps the same place across the cell relative to the standing point in all 8 frames (at most 1 square up or down); the ponytail streams back and bounces a little; frame 8 flows into frame 1.
Layout: exactly like the SECOND image - 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 animation frames, each cell 96x96 squares (768x768 px), 3072x1536 pixels; frame N in the same cell as in the SECOND image; unused cells stay empty. Transparent background (if not possible: solid #FF00FF magenta). No grid lines, no borders, no labels, no guide marks.
Before finishing, check: every square 8x8 on one grid, only the FIRST image's colors, the head identical to the FIRST image in every frame, both eyes visible and level, the kunai in the near hand and the kama in the far hand, nothing below the feet line, the frames in the same cells as the SECOND image.
Exact per-cell pivot x (logical pixels), in frame order: [47, 47, 47, 48, 48, 48, 48, 47]. Pivot y is 70. The soles are at y81, not at the pivot. Do not render these numbers.
Make ONE complete sprite sheet, not a single pose. Every frame is a distinct pose in the specified animation. Preserve character mass and the short 46-pixel body. Use plain transparent margins between cells. Read left-to-right then top-to-bottom.

QUALITY REVISION: the user rejected the earlier crude eyes and inconsistent character. FIRST image is the revised sharp-eyed design, superseding ALL prior versions. Use this design for ALL frames. Maintain clean strong pixel clusters, ample tan nose bridge, readable near and far eyes, no robot rectangle eye whites. No lighting effects or semitransparent aura. Weapons must be exactly one pointed triangular kunai and one curved kama in every nonthrow pose, attached to the correct hands. Motion comes from proper bending limbs and torso, not just shifting the standing sprite. The loop must have clear alternating leg strides. Native 46-pixel body, do NOT enlarge limbs or make the costume more complex.
